how_to_use: Generator for docs/story/IDEA_ENGINE.md. An idea = one value from each axis A-G. Prefer adjacent-novelty moves on proven families. Check saturation flags. Score with rubric. Proven signals come from data/story/competitors (views at 2026-10-26; multiple = views / channel median).

A_power_family.note: Strongest vein. Stop/freeze time, see-the-future and rewind-10-seconds are SATURATED; perception twists are not.
Cleanest title shape. Speed and strength are taken by big channels; new body parts are open.
IQ/genius cluster proven (1.4M, 865K) and now crowded. Skill acquisition is the open angle.
Fire, lightning, ice and air already exist on small channels. Physics-law rules (conservation) give great costs.

examples: doors connect to any door you've opened
A_power_family.note: Teleport SATURATED (5 channels); swap/conditional variants open.
Fits our cards/overlays perfectly; gamer appeal.

examples: heal anyone you touch (take their injury)
A_power_family.note: Healing faster and no pain are SATURATED. Transfer/owner swaps are open.
Hearing-only underperforms (Hear 10x Better 4.6K). Sound becomes strong when it is VISIBLE (shockwaves, ripples).
Targets objects instead of self: easy visual demos.

examples: skip any part of your life
A_power_family.note: Game-like rules. Money Grew 10x 893K. Respawn taken (120K).

B_number.use: when 10x is too small to be dramatic (sound, jumping, reflexes)

D_cost.example: square-cube law: 10x bigger = 1,000x heavier but 100x stronger
reaction 0.2 s, flicker fusion ~60 Hz, fovea ~2 degrees
braking distance, landing impact speed sqrt(2gh)
crowds of echoes, noise as visuals
pacemakers near magnets, ears near 120 dB
copies take your mass; cooling something heats you

F_dilemma.shape: full power would hurt the person you save; win with restraint + rule
saving someone exposes the power / costs the trail
win the final or save the kid
you can only redirect danger onto someone/something else
expose a lie or protect a loving one
lose the power / a skill slot / body mass to save others
the dark choice: take the prize, let them crash

G_series.part2_escalation: same premise, bigger number ('10 Minutes' -> '10 Years'); stop at Part 3
G_series.counter_power: the cliffhanger power that beats this one = next episode's idea

adjacent_novelty_moves.example: reaction time 10x (4.5M) -> heart beat 10x (564K on a 29K-median channel) -> eyes 10x faster
see the future -> see the past; stop time -> slow only what you look at
shrink yourself -> enlarge objects; heal yourself -> heal others by taking their injury
copy objects, but copies take your body mass
learn any skill, but only 3 slots
